Game Overview

Shadows of the Forest is a horror game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Shadows of the Forest is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Shadows of the Forest?

Shadows of the Forest is a free horror game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Shadows of the Forest free to play?

Yes, Shadows of the Forest is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
